name: ai-plugins
description: Esutoru plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: esutoru-wordmine
plugins.description: Esutoru Wordmine plugin (work in progress). Turns words and phrases into Anki cards through AnkiConnect: setup verifies Anki, AnkiConnect, the deck, the note type and the languages; prepare-words collects the words from the conversation into a reviewed set; add-to-anki creates the cards.
